title: Where a suburban Colorado school district's 2025 bond places its 24 new elementary classrooms under the board's placement standard, from each school's projected enrollment over 2028-29 to 2032-33
subdomain: population-estimation-demographic-projection (a small-area cohort-component projection of each attendance area's K-5 pupils: cohorts aged through grades, kindergartens from births five years earlier, exits and moves between areas as rates on the area a pupil leaves, arrivals from outside the district as counts)
prompt_shape: a placement schedule for seven schools (each school's classroom need and classrooms placed), two October 1, 2026 tables (homeroom classes by grade band at seven schools; preschool children and classrooms at four sites), and a seven-panel enrollment chart

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task150/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Colorado school district (Sorrel Creek School District RE-6, Brandt County), its schools, board, county vital records office and their systems; no real organisation, person or system is depicted. Grade, entry and school code conventions follow common Colorado student information practice; the board policy code follows the NEPN/NSBA classification.
